paper.title_en: QUAPLA : a library for quantum exact linear algebra
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce QUAPLA (Quantum Python Linear Algebra), a new Python package that implements basic finite field arithmetic on scalars and matrices on a quantum computer. More precisely, QUAPLA is a new module of QARTON [36], a recent general-purpose software library for quantum cryptanalysis. QUAPLA extends QARTON by providing, in particular, quantum circuit implementations of the Berlekamp-Massey algorithm and Wiedemann's algorithm for fields of odd characteristic and their extensions, as well as parametrized resource estimates for these circuits.
